pages.text: Hemp is the core resource crop of this mod. Plant hemp seeds on $(bold)tilled farmland$() adjacent to water and wait — or speed things up with $(bold)fertilizers$().$(br)$(br)Hemp grows through $(bold)11 age stages (0–10)$(). The plant is two blocks tall once fully grown. You can shear leaves from the plant up to 3 times before it must be fully harvested.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Fully grown harvest drops:$()$(br)• Hemp Leaf$(br)• Hemp Seeds$(br)• Hemp Fibers$(br)$(br)These are your primary resources for building the entire material chain.

pages.title: Hemp Plant
pages.text: A fully grown Hemp plant (age 10). Two blocks tall.

$(bold)What you need Hemp for:$()$(br)• $(bold)Hemp Leaf$() → Bio Composite (crafting) or via Extractor$(br)• $(bold)Hemp Fibers$() → Hemp Hammer, Drying Rack, Manual Grinder, Hemp Fabric$(br)• $(bold)Hemp Seeds$() → DNA Strands (via Extractor), first compost$(br)$(br)$(bold)Tip:$() Use $(bold)Bone Meal$() on the crop to accelerate growth. Plant many hemp crops early — you will need large quantities of all three drops.
